name: Tinted amber glass slab desk

reasons: Single three-quarter view: the back long edge of the top, the inner faces of both end panels and the entire underside are not directly readable.
Object is transparent/translucent tinted glass — per-zone albedo read through overlapping layers, so panel hex values approximate a transmissive material rather than opaque albedo.
The four bronze L-brackets are ~0.10 m long and partly silhouetted against the top slab; plate outline, boss count and fixing method are authored procedurally as a simple 90 deg angle plate.
No ground contact shadow and a near-white studio sweep make camera placement and absolute scale inference-based (desk-height convention 0.72-0.75 m used).
Bilaterally symmetric about the vertical plane at mid-span, so the hidden right end panel and its bracket pair mirror the visible left flank.

detailInventory.evidence: A continuous 0.015-0.020 m tall bright line runs the full 1.40 m front edge of the top, lighter than the face above it, indicating a flat-polished glass edge with a ~0.002 m arris.

detailInventory.zone: junction of top slab underside and left end panel, front corner
detailInventory.evidence: An angular dark-brown element, ~0.10 m along the panel and ~0.06 m along the underside of the top, sits immediately below the top at the front top corner of the left panel; two straight arms meeting at ~90 deg.

detailInventory.zone: junction of top slab underside and left end panel, rear corner
detailInventory.evidence: A second, near-identical dark angular element appears ~0.50 m behind the front one along the same top-of-panel line, partly overlapped by the amber glass it is seen through.

detailInventory.zone: junction of top slab underside and right end panel, front and rear corners
detailInventory.evidence: Two dark angular marks of the same size and spacing sit under the far end of the top where the right panel meets it, one at each corner of that panel's top edge.

detailInventory.zone: top slab perimeter over both end panels
detailInventory.evidence: The vertical amber faces of both end panels start 0.03-0.05 m inboard of the top slab's outer edges, so the top reads as a cantilevered lid with a shadow gap under its perimeter.

detailInventory.zone: left end panel, bottom edge, front and rear corners
detailInventory.evidence: Two small pale square patches, ~0.02 m on a side, interrupt the dark amber at the very bottom corners of the left panel, one at each end of its bottom edge.
The left panel is lighter and warmer near its top edge and progressively darker and browner toward its bottom edge, with the darkest value in the lowest ~0.15 m.
A single soft bright sheet spans most of the top face with no texture or weave breaking it, and the far half of the top face is lighter than the near half.
The bottom edge of the left panel reads as a crisp straight line ~0.015 m thick with no separate foot rail, plinth or leg attached.

detailInventory.zone: left end panel, outer face, lower front corner
detailInventory.evidence: A faint pale rectangular mark, roughly 0.03 x 0.02 m, sits ~0.04 m above the bottom edge near the front corner of the left panel, distinct from the two glide pads.

localFeatures.evidence: Continuous 0.015-0.020 m bright line along the whole front edge of the top, lighter than the face above.

localFeatures.evidence: A single soft bright sheet spans most of the top face with no texture breaking it.

materials.subtype: amber body-tinted float glass, 0.018 m thick, flat-polished edges
amber body-tinted float glass slab, 0.015 m thick, transmissive with vertical absorption gradient

mustMatch: Exactly three flat slabs and nothing else: one horizontal top 1.400 x 0.680 x 0.018 m whose upper face is 0.730 m above the floor, and two vertical end panels 0.015 m thick — no apron, stretcher, drawer or leg.

The end panels' outer faces are 1.305 m apart (each face 0.040 m inboard of the top's end) and each panel is 0.600 m deep, inset 0.040 m from both the front and rear edges of the top, giving a continuous overhang shadow gap on all four sides.

Each end panel stands vertical (rotation 0) with its bottom edge on the floor and 0.712 m of exposed face between floor and the underside of the top; panel thickness reads 0.015 m at the bottom edge line.

Four bronze L-brackets, one per panel top corner: vertical arm 0.100 m tall on the panel face, horizontal arm 0.060 m under the top, 0.005 m plate, 0.035 m wide, the pair on each panel 0.500 m apart along the depth axis (z = +0.25 and z = -0.25).
A polished edge band 0.018 m tall, lighter than the face above it (#C98B50 vs #9C5A28), runs the full 1.400 m of the top's front edge and round the whole perimeter.
Two 0.020 x 0.020 m pale glide pads at the bottom corners of each panel, centres 0.030 m inboard of the panel's front and rear edges, and no other hardware anywhere on the panels.
niceToHave: Vertical tint gradient on the panel outer faces: #B06A32 at the top edge, #8E4A1C at mid height, #6A3210 in the lowest 0.15 m.
Single unbroken specular sheet across the top face with the far half brighter than the near half.
Faint 0.03 x 0.02 m etched mark on the left panel outer face, 0.055 m above the bottom edge near the front corner.
0.002 m arris lines top and bottom of every polished glass edge.
Faint highlight along the 90 deg fold of each bracket and two 0.006 m fixing bosses per arm.
Neutral studio sweep ground with no cast shadow, so panel darkening comes from lighting rather than baked texture.
